name: bishop_of_wings_two_angels_entering_at_once_trigger_it_twice
notes: Printed: 'Whenever an Angel you control enters, you gain 4 life.' One trigger for each Angel, also when one effect puts both onto the battlefield at the same moment. Seat 0's two Angels die first (the Bishop makes a Spirit for each: two Spirit tokens, which is the other half of the card). Brought Back ({W}{W}, 'up to two target permanent cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn') returns both Angels tapped in one instruction: two triggers, seat 0 gains 4 twice (28).
